id_note: review_id is the review sequence number and Q the machine candidate queue number; formula_id is the formula unique key, matching machine_formula_records.jsonl and machine_formula_trees.jsonl across files
source_file: source PDF filename; the source PDF is not distributed
source_pdf_sha256: SHA-256 of the source PDF, for identifying the same edition
candidate_number: candidate formula sequence number within the page
locator: locator string of the form filename#page=…#candidate=…#bbox=…
human_transcription_latex: human LaTeX transcription checked symbol by symbol against the page
latex: final LaTeX; parsed from the same text as tree_preorder
tree_preorder: final formula tree (preorder); the reference for both training and evaluation
m_labels: final M structural-pattern label set (M01–M12), sorted and deduplicated
m_labels_status: defect=matches at least one M01–M12 structural pattern; no_defect=empty set with a faithful tree, a valid negative; tree_unsound=tree unusable, labels not used as training/evaluation targets
m_labels_origin: human_verdict=labels adjudicated by the reviewer record by record; tree_rule_derivation=labels recorded by the reviewer during tree-level verification against the M01–M12 structural rules
m_label_adjudication: original human M-label adjudication text; kept only when it matches the final m_labels exactly; empty string means no separate label adjudication for this record
parse_mode: standard=standard parsing; safe_relaxed=relaxed parsing that still preserves structure; lossy_heuristic=heuristic parsing (always loses information, never enters the usable set)
parse_fidelity: parse fidelity gate result: passed / failed / unsupported
tree_verdict: faithful=final tree faithful; faithful_source_merged=faithful but the source itself writes the symbols adjacent; broken=final tree still loses structure; excluded_engine_gap=engine lacks a node and cannot produce a faithful tree
loss_kinds: structural loss type codes; non-empty when tree_verdict is broken or faithful_source_merged
tree_verdict_basis: basis for the tree verdict: human_page=page-level item-by-item verification; tree_review=tree-level re-inspection; gate_replay=canonical rewrite then item-by-item check; rule_check=structural-rule item-by-item check; engine_gap=engine-gap verification
usable_for_train: final tree and labels usable as training data
usable_for_eval: final tree usable as an evaluation reference; a target-quality flag, not a held-out split; all eval records are also in the train set; `splits/` provides a disjoint train/test partition
machine_ocr_latex: machine OCR LaTeX from the frozen run (before repair)
machine_tree_preorder: machine formula tree from the frozen run (before repair)
machine_m_labels: M-labels assigned by the frozen engine on the machine tree (before repair)
machine_tree_fidelity_status: tree-fidelity gate result of the frozen engine itself
defect_locus: first defect location identified by the review (before repair): formula tree / OCR / M-label
engine_gap_kind: category of the missing engine node; empty string means no engine gap
final_status: usable=usable for training and evaluation; train_only=training only; tree_distorted=tree distortion; engine_gap=engine gap
text_changed: whether the final text differs from the machine OCR
machine_record_note: review note: the specific defect or verification basis of the pre-repair machine OCR/tree/labels; the final state is given by tree_verdict and final_status
tree_duplicate_group: group number DT01–DT11 when the same final formula tree occurs in multiple records; empty string means the tree is unique
review_method: review method; all records are single-person item-by-item verification, no cross-review
engine_sha256: SHA-256 of the frozen engine file used for parsing and labeling
formula_id: formula unique key; matches machine_formula_records.jsonl and machine_formula_trees.jsonl, and never collides with a Gold formula_id
review_id: review sequence number; R for the initial batch, Q for the machine core candidate queue
source_id: book identifier; matches book_id in the source catalogue
source_title: book title as recorded in the source catalogue
source_title_zh: book title as recorded in Chinese in the source catalogue
